svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Rank your sources before you read
svg.desc: A ranked list of four sources, strongest first: one, the licence text, which binds you; two, the vendor's documentation; three, the running binary, used as the tiebreak; four, everyone else, including this blog. On the right, two cases where a lower-ranked source lost. Case one, toward optimism: a community blog said the community edition runs fully offline; Clause 4 of the licence reserves a periodic licence check; the licence wins, because the blog described observed behaviour and the licence describes reserved rights. Case two, toward pessimism: a secondary source said 8 concurrent connections and KX's documentation said 16; running .Q.lim on the installed binary reported 16; the documentation was right. The footer says: wrong in both directions, so not even a consistent bias; decide the ranking before you read.
svg.text: RANK YOUR SOURCES BEFORE YOU READ
Twice a secondary source beat the primary one in my notes. Twice it was wrong.
Licence, clause 4: a periodic licence check
Observed behaviour is not a reserved right.
binary reports 16. The docs were right.
The conservative number was not the safe one.
Wrong in both directions, so not even a consistent bias. Decide the ranking before you read, not after.
